in_sanskrit.name: Erfan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Experienced, knowledgeable, wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Erfan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Erfan means 'experienced' or 'knowledgeable' in Persian language. It is derived from the word 'arafan' which means 'to know'. Erfan is a name that signifies wisdom and tranquility. It is a name for a boy who is believed to be experienced and knowledgeable, one who has gained deep insights and understanding through experience.
